sections.title: Valuation Insights
sections.text: Operating margin is [[V.ratio.operating_margin]] percent, reflecting strong profitability relative to revenue. Return on average equity stands at [[V.ratio.return_on_average_equity]] percent, indicating efficient use of shareholders’ capital. Debt to equity, including the current portion, is [[V.ratio.debt_to_equity]] times, showing a moderate leverage profile. Free cash flow amounts to [[V.ratio.free_cash_flow]] dollars, underscoring robust cash generation after capital expenditures. The price‑earnings multiple based on the latest filed annual diluted EPS is [[V.ratio.price_earnings]] times, providing a valuation gauge against earnings. Total revenue for the fiscal year is [[V.fact.revenue]] dollars, and GAAP diluted EPS is [[V.fact.diluted_eps]] dollars per share, both reported under GAAP conventions for the common Class A share class. Capital expenditures of [[V.fact.capex]] dollars represent cash outlays for property, equipment and technology.

insight.text: Free cash flow of [[V.ratio.free_cash_flow]] dollars highlights the company’s ability to fund growth and return capital to shareholders.
